title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E05 — Shady Glen
Seth and his team protect civilians from cannibal attacks.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E06 — Straitjacket
Richie wakes up in an abandoned asylum after being abducted; Seth goes to save Richie.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E07 — La Llorona
The team falls victim to a female Xibalban demon.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E08 — Rio Sangre
Santanico returns with a secret and leads the Geckos to Lord Venganza.

title: The King of Fighters
description: Members of three legendary clans fight battles in other dimensions.

title: Dangerous
description: An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death.

title: Python
description: Developed by the military, a massive snake escapes from its pen and stalks the residents of a small town.

title: Python 2
description: Genetically enhanced snakes go on a killing spree inside a Russian military base.

title: Bleeding Steel
description: Hong Kong police inspector Lin Dong learns that a biochemical invention has been surgically implanted into his missing daughter. With help from a hacker, Lin tries to connect the dots between the device, a sinister army and a strange phenomenon.

title: Safe
description: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.

title: Debt Collectors
description: Debt collectors French and Sue head to Las Vegas to collect money owed to their boss Tommy, while evading a drug kingpin out for revenge.

title: Accident Man
description: Mike Fallon is a seasoned hit man who is known for making his target's death look like an accident. When Fallon's girlfriend turns up dead, he goes after his old colleagues to find the one responsible.

title: Accident Man: Hitman's Holiday
description: A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world to protect the ungrateful son of a mafia boss, save the life of his only friend, and rekindle his relationship with his maniacal father figure.

title: Alone in the Dark
description: A paranormal investigator (Christian Slater), an anthropologist (Tara Reid) and a team of agents battle deadly monsters.

title: Venomous
description: Doctors (Treat Williams, Mary Page Keller) try to find a cure for a deadly virus inflicted by rattlesnake bites.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E04 — Locking in the Last Minute Details
Alejandro gets creative with casting in order to fill one of his crucial roles; the filmmakers put their negotiating skills to the test as they bargain to lock in the locations.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E09 — Matanzas
The Geckos are going after Amaru, as she plots to regain her true form and open the gates of Hell.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E10 — Dark Side of the Sun
As Kate nears death, the team races to defeat Amaru and seal the gate to Xibalba.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
Bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko head for the Mexican border, encountering a deadly standoff at a liquor store along the way; Richie is haunted by visions of demons and a mysterious woman.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E02 — Blood Runs Thick
The Gecko brothers flee the liquor store with Ranger Freddie Gonzalez in pursuit; Richie's visions escalate; the Geckos nearly collide with the Fullers, a troubled family making its own desperate journey to Mexico.

title: Agent Red
description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility.

title: Duchess
description: Duchess, a small-time crook, tries to enter the treacherous underworld of diamond trafficking and ends up left for dead when a deal goes wrong. Determined to seek retribution she launches into an unwavering pursuit for vengeance.

title: The Doorman
description: A former soldier must save her niece and nephew from armed thieves planning to steal priceless art from a building in New York City.

title: The Foreigner
description: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

title: The Perfect Weapon
description: An expert in "kenpo" karate avenges his Chinatown friend, slain by a mobster in Los Angeles.

title: The Last Stand
description: A sheriff must take matters into his own hands when a notorious drug lord escapes from FBI custody and comes speeding toward a showdown in the lawman's quiet border town.

title: The Boondock Saints
description: Two brothers (Sean Patrick Flanery, Norman Reedus), believing themselves to be on a mission from God, begin killing members of Boston's underworld.

title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
description: While visiting an excavation site in Kenya, a former priest sees signs of demonic possession.

title: Villains
description: Amateur criminals stumble upon a dark secret in a sadistic couple's home.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E03 — Mistress
Richie struggles with his visions; Seth makes a plan with Carlos to cross the border; the Fullers suffer an RV breakdown; Ranger Gonzalez seeks help from an expert.

title: Meltdown
description: A faded action-star's (Jacky Cheung) bodyguard (Jet Li) saves his reputation and his life during a jewel heist.

title: Dredd
description: In a violent, futuristic metropolis, a law-enforcement officer (Karl Urban) and his rookie trainee (Olivia Thirlby) become caught up in a high-stakes conflict with a vicious prostitute-turned-drug lord (Lena Headey).

title: Acts of Violence
description: A man teams up with his ex-military brothers and a detective to save his kidnapped fiancée from human traffickers.

title: Redemption
description: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

title: Empire State
description: A security guard (Liam Hemsworth) and his childhood pal (Michael Angarano) make plans to rob an armored car.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

title: American Sicario
description: American gangster Erik Vasquez schemes to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

title: Killing Them Softly
description: After a rival crook hires a pair of bumbling thieves (Scoot McNairy, Ben Mendelsohn) to rob their card game, mobsters hire a reluctant hit man (Brad Pitt) to settle the score.

title: Black Christmas
description: Sorority sisters (Olivia Hussey, Margot Kidder) and their drunken housemother fall prey to an obscene yuletide caller.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E09 — Time is Running Out
Josh feels the pressure of first-time filmmaking as actors fail to stick to their script, and decisions pertaining to technical scenes and paying his actors weigh on his conscience.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E04 — Let's Get Ramblin'
Seth and Richie take the Fuller family hostage and attempt to leave the motel undetected, but Freddie -- led by the same force that has been guiding Richie -- arrives at their door, igniting a clash that nearly destroys them all.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E05 — Self-Contained
After a daring escape from the motel, Seth leads the Fullers' RV to the border crossing; an irrational fear takes hold of Richie; Jacob Fuller takes control of a volatile situation, determined to get his children safely across the border.

title: In the Name of the King: A Dungeon Siege Tale
description: As war looms in an idyllic kingdom, a man (Jason Statham) sets out to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claire Forlani) and avenge their murdered son.
